title: Should Service Requirements Be Scalarized or Constrained When Minimizing Costs? A Case Study on HVAC Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.33946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated decision systems, from learned policies to model-based optimizers, often minimize costs such as energy or resource use while meeting a service requirement, for example the quality of service (QoS) specified in a service level agreement (SLA), a comfort band, or a safety margin. The requirement can be scalarized with the costs into a single objective, with a fixed or an adaptively tuned (Lagrangian) weight, or it can be imposed as a constraint. We study this choice in the Smart Buildings Challenge, in which a single policy controls the heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) of previously unseen buildings and is evaluated by a weighted sum of comfort, energy cost and carbon emissions. translated_title: 最小化成本时，服务需求应被标量化还是作为约束？——以暖通空调（HVAC）控制为例的案例研究
translated_abstract: 自动化决策系统——从学习到的策略到基于模型的优化器——通常需要在满足服务需求的同时最小化成本，例如能源或资源消耗。服务需求的例子包括服务水平协议（SLA）中规定的服务质量（QoS）、舒适度区间或安全裕度。这一需求既可以与成本一起标量化为单一目标（采用固定权重或自适应调整的拉格朗日权重），也可以作为约束条件加以施加。我们在智能建筑挑战赛中研究这一选择：在该挑战赛中，单一策略控制此前未见过的建筑的供暖、通风与空调（HVAC）系统，并通过舒适度、能源成本和碳排放的加权和进行评估。在固定所有其他组件的前提下，我们比较了两种处理方式：在以模型预测控制（MPC）为代表的基于模型的优化中，将需求作为硬约束或软（l1惩罚）约束；在学习到的策略中……
tldr: 本文以智能建筑挑战赛中的HVAC控制为案例，系统比较了在最小化成本时将服务需求标量化为单一目标（固定或拉格朗日权重）与将其作为硬/软约束两种处理方式的效果差异。
en_tdlr: This paper compares scalarizing service requirements with costs into a single objective (using fixed or Lagrangian weights) versus imposing them as hard or soft constraints, through a case study on HVAC control in the Smart Buildings Challenge.
